how_to_use: Take a FRESH checkout of this commit, run verify_device_baseline.py, and gather device evidence only from a build of that tree. Evidence from any other tree is not evidence about this baseline. Record the commit beside every capture.
which_commit_to_check_out: Not necessarily the commit named in `commit` below. That is where the Swift tree was ESTABLISHED (the merge of #107); this receipt and its verifier are necessarily added by a LATER commit, so a checkout of 413a68f would not contain them. Check out the commit on main that carries this file, and run the verifier: it hashes the Swift tree directly, so a PASS proves that checkout's Swift is the baseline regardless of which commit you are standing on. The receipt cannot name its own sha without being wrong the moment it is amended, so it states a property the verifier recomputes instead.
